meta.title: Users with Account Compromise Alerts
meta.desc: Lists users tied to Sentinel alerts that suggest possible account compromise and publishes the normalized user list for downstream cards.

input.query: let lookback = {{lookbackDays}}d; let candidateAlerts = SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback) | extend alertText = strcat(' ', tolower(coalesce(AlertName, '')), ' ', tolower(coalesce(Description, '')), ' ') | where alertText has_any ('compromise','compromised','credential','password spray','impossible travel','risky sign-in','risky user','suspicious sign-in','brute force','token theft') or tolower(coalesce(CompromisedEntity,'')) contains '@' | project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProviderName, CompromisedEntity, Entities, AlertId = coalesce(SystemAlertId, VendorOriginalId, tostring(_ItemId)); candidateAlerts | extend EntitiesArray = todynamic(Entities) | mv-expand Entity = iff(isnull(EntitiesArray), dynamic([{}]), EntitiesArray) | extend entityType = tostring(Entity.Type), entityName = tostring(Entity.Name), entitySuffix = tostring(Entity.UPNSuffix), entityAddress = tostring(Entity.Address) | extend user = tolower(trim(' ', tostring(coalesce(CompromisedEntity, iff(entityType =~ 'account' and isnotempty(entityName) and isnotempty(entitySuffix), strcat(entityName, '@', entitySuffix), ''), iff(entityType =~ 'account' and isnotempty(entityAddress), entityAddress, ''))))) | where isnotempty(user) and user contains '@' | summarize alertCount = dcount(AlertId), highSeverityCount = countif(AlertSeverity =~ 'High'), mediumSeverityCount = countif(AlertSeverity =~ 'Medium'), firstAlert = min(TimeGenerated), latestAlert = max(TimeGenerated), sampleAlerts = make_set(AlertName, 5), providers = make_set(ProviderName, 3) by user | extend sampleAlerts = strcat_array(sampleAlerts, '; '), providers = strcat_array(providers, ', ') | order by latestAlert desc
